40:8.text: "Our Lord! And make them enter the ‘Adn
which you have promised them - and to the righteous among their fathers, their wives, and their offspring! Verily, You are the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

40:9.text: (the punishment, for what they did of)
the sins, and whomsoever You save from
(the punishment for what he did of)
that Day, him verily, You have taken into mercy." And that is the supreme success.

40:10.text: Those who disbelieve will be addressed
(at the time of entering the Fire)
(in the worldly life when you used to reject the Faith)
than your aversion towards one another
(now in the Fire of Hell, as you are now enemies to one another)
, when you were called to the Faith but you used to refuse."

40:11.text: They will say: "Our Lord! You have made us to die twice
(i.e. we were dead in the loins of our fathers and dead after our life in this world)
, and You have given us life twice
(i.e. life when we were born and life when we are Resurrected)
! Now we confess our sins, then is there any way to get out

40:12.text: : "This is because, when Allâh Alone was invoked
, but when partners were joined to Him, you believed! So the judgement is only with Allâh, the Most High, the Most Great!

40:13.text: It is He Who shows you His Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
provision for you from the sky. And none remembers but those who turn
(by begging His Pardon and by worshipping and obeying Him Alone and none else)

40:14.text: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and the believers)
(by worshipping none but Him and by doing religious deeds sincerely for Allâh’s sake only and not to show off and not to set up rivals with Him in worship)

40:15.text: Owner of High Ranks and Degrees, the Owner of the Throne. He sends the revelation by His Command to any of His slaves He wills, that he
of the Day of Mutual Meeting

40:16.text: come out, nothing of them will be hidden from Allâh. Whose is the kingdom this Day?
(Allâh Himself will reply to His Question)
: It is Allâh’s the One, the Irresistible!
